title: Elara and the Clockwork Secret
logline: A curious girl uncovers a magical Clockwork Owl and a Floating Key to unlock a wondrous Secret Attic Library, filled with endless stories.

character_bible.name: Elara
character_bible.visual_appearance: A small human child with bright ginger hair tied in two neat braided pigtails, sparkling emerald green eyes, and a sprinkle of freckles across her nose.
character_bible.signature_clothing: A soft, forest-green velvet tunic with embroidered silver leaf patterns, marigold yellow leggings, and sturdy, soft brown leather ankle boots.
character_bible.distinct_accessories: A small, intricately carved wooden bird pendant on a thin silver chain around her neck.
character_bible.personality_trait: Inquisitive, brave, and full of wonder

scenes.title: The Ticking Mystery
scenes.narrative_text: On a rainy afternoon, Elara, a girl with bright ginger pigtails and a green tunic, felt a bit bored. Suddenly, a faint, rhythmic ticking sound drifted from the dusty attic above. Her emerald eyes widened with curiosity, wondering what new adventure awaited her.

scenes.title: A Hidden Passage
scenes.narrative_text: Following the intriguing tick-tock, Elara tiptoed through the attic. Behind an old, faded tapestry, she discovered a small, intricately carved wooden door. With a gentle push, it creaked open, revealing a dimly lit, winding staircase leading up into deeper shadows, promising a secret.

scenes.title: The Library's Guardian
scenes.narrative_text: At the top, Elara found a grand, heavy door, clearly leading to the Secret Attic Library. Perched on a tall, dusty shelf nearby was a magnificent Clockwork Owl, its metallic feathers gleaming. Just above its head, a shimmering Floating Key spun slowly, tantalizingly out of reach.

scenes.title: A Whispered Secret
scenes.narrative_text: Elara noticed a tiny, ornate winding key on the Clockwork Owl's side. Gently, she turned it. The owl’s emerald eyes flickered to life, and it let out a soft, melodious hoot. With a magical shimmer, the Floating Key slowly descended, landing perfectly in Elara's outstretched hand. She gasped, ready to unlock the library!

scenes.title: Worlds of Wonder Unlocked
scenes.narrative_text: With the Floating Key, Elara unlocked the heavy door. Inside, the Secret Attic Library stretched before her, a breathtaking sight! Shelves stacked with ancient books glowed with soft light, and the air hummed with stories. The Clockwork Owl blinked contentedly from its perch, a silent guardian of this magical place.
